question: Does the R5 raw-byte instruction representation remain useful under semantically equivalent case, whitespace, and punctuation surface changes that were absent from training?
hypothesis: The unchanged R5 chain will preserve at least 0.90 exact raw-output accuracy on original heldout instructions and punctuation-only or doubled-space variants, but tab-for-space and ASCII-uppercase variants will each fall to at most 0.25 exact raw-output accuracy, exposing a missing surface-invariance mechanism.

prior_evidence.observation: R5 achieved 0.9609375 heldout full representation accuracy, 0.96875 reasoning accuracy, and 0.96875 exact raw-output accuracy with zero tokenizer use.

scope_statement: This tests only byte-surface robustness of the current bounded instruction mechanism. It does not claim or require semantic paraphrase understanding.
authority: research-only; no deployment, external-model inference, scheduler, queue, accepted-ref, production, broker, or live-interface authority
training: byte-identical R5 training corpus and R5 learned operation/value anchors, operation model, reasoner, and three-byte generator; no retraining on perturbations

variants: replace '?' with '.' in template 4 and trailing '.' with '!' in template 5; all letters/spaces unchanged
replace each ASCII space byte 0x20 with two consecutive 0x20 bytes
replace each ASCII space byte 0x20 with ASCII tab 0x09
map bytes 'a'..'z' to 'A'..'Z'; all nonletters unchanged

validity_criteria: Exact parent and North Star identities match.
R5 learned state is reused unchanged and no perturbation example participates in training.
Each perturbation is a deterministic byte transformation of the same 128 heldout examples and preserves evaluator operation/operand/answer labels.
Prediction receives transformed raw bytes only; evaluator labels are scoring-only.
No normalization, lowercasing, whitespace canonicalization, tokenizer, parser, or adaptive repair is added.
Full Go regression passes before the probe and all metrics are finite.
No external model, network call, capacity growth, threshold adaptation, or post-result tuning occurs.

classification_rules.surface_invariance_falsified: Validity passes; original control remains strong; punctuation and double-space remain strong; tab and uppercase each collapse to at most 0.25 exact output.
classification_rules.survives_falsification: Validity passes and all four transformed variants retain at least 0.90 exact raw-output accuracy.
classification_rules.mixed: Validity passes but outcomes fall between those two patterns.
classification_rules.incomplete: Compute interruption prevents the frozen evaluation matrix.
classification_rules.invalid: Any training contamination, label drift, transformation drift, evaluator leakage, normalization, capacity, or qualification criterion fails.

no_post_result_tuning_rule: No perturbation transform, learned state, metric, threshold, or interpretation may change after primary output.
